title: Ground, entity-check and critic-verify enriched funding data (ENG-122)
body:
Fixes ENG-122 — lead enrichment returned fabricated / inaccurate company funding data (a "Slashy" lead labelled **Series C, $100M**, which is *Slash's* funding).

> **Note:** this PR originally only dropped uncited web-tier values. Investigation showed that gate was **presence-only** — it checked that the model *supplied* a quote, never that the quote was real or that it supported the value. The scope grew accordingly. Title and description updated to match what actually ships.

## Root cause

Three distinct defects, each independently able to surface another company's funding as fact:

1. **No grounding.** The web tier accepted any value the model returned as long as it attached *some* quote. Fabricated figures shipped with `confidence: high`.
2. **No entity check.** A web search for "Slashy" returns pages about **Slash**. Its funding and its LinkedIn page were written onto the Slashy lead.
3. **The critic never ran.** The pass designed to catch exactly this 400s on every call (`temperature: 0` against a deployment that only accepts the default) and the error was swallowed into a `console.warn` that returned empty verdicts — while enrichment reported `ok=true`. **Zero verdicts, ever.**

## What changed

**Grounding** (`enrichmentGrounding.ts`, `enrichmentV3RealDeps.ts`)
- Every web-tier value is classified `grounded` | `web-unverified` | `ai-knowledge` and carries that tag through to the UI and to Emma.
- A cited quote is the model's **evidence, and is binding**: it must exist in the fetched source *and* support the value. Previously a real quote for a *different field* laundered any answer into `grounded`/`high` (Facebook's `funding_stage` came back `"Grant (prize money)"` quoting the `total_funding` sentence).
- Figures still ground across formatting (`$100M` ≡ `$100 million`).

**Wrong-entity guard**
- `companyNameMatches` is a strict token match (`Slash` ≠ `Slashy`, `Quill AI` ≠ `Quillwork AI`), folded together with an alias-aware `__entity_matches_lead__` the model returns **inside the existing extraction call** (no extra LLM round-trip).
- The model's boolean is **authoritative in both directions**; the token match is only the fallback when it is silent. A live trace caught the model echoing the lead's own name into `__entity_company__` while answering `matchesLead=false` — the echo was overriding the denial.
- Company-level LinkedIn URLs are now identity-checked and **fail closed** (kept only when the source company is positively confirmed). Person-level `linkedin_url` stays exempt.

**Critic** (`llmService.ts`)
- `temperature` may be `null`, which omits the parameter for deployments that reject a custom value. The critic opts in via `CRM_ENRICH_V3_CRITIC_TEMPERATURE` (default: omit).
- The swallowed `warn` is now a loud `error` — a disabled safety net must never look like a healthy one.

**Presentation** (`enrichedFieldValue.ts`, `emma/tools.ts`, `emma/enrichmentToolRunner.ts`)
- `fieldVerificationStatus()` accounts for grounding; Emma is told to caveat unverified values and cite sources.

## ⚠️ Intentional behaviour change

**Users will see fewer "verified" values and more 🟡 unverified badges.** That is the fix, not a regression — previously unverifiable data was shown with no caveat. **This needs a release note and a heads-up to CS.**

Nothing is silently deleted: a value that stops being `grounded` falls to `web-unverified` — kept, badged, `confidence: low`. Only values that are both unverifiable *and* attributable to the wrong company are dropped. Apollo (`source: 'api'`) values are untouched throughout.

Backward compatible: legacy records have no `grounding` field and skip the new checks.

## Verified live

Against a clean 4-lead list (zero sibling sources, so no cached copies):

| Lead | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| **Slashy** | `funding_stage: Series C`, `companyLinkedin: company/joinslash` | both **absent** |
| **Quillwork AI** | `company/quill-ai` | **dropped** (`claimed="Quill AI"`) |
| **Facebook** | — | `$2.27B` `grounded` + `criticVerdict: supported`, real quote |
| **Stripe** | — | Apollo values unchanged (control) |

The critic executed for the first time in its life and **dropped nothing** — it downgraded one unsupported value rather than deleting it.

## Testing

`tsc` clean · **324 tests green** across the ENG-122 and `llmService.*` suites, after merging latest `main` (no conflicts). Each fix was written test-first, with the failing test verified red before the change.

## Known-open, out of scope (separate tickets)

1. **P0 — the same temperature 400 kills every other plain-path LLM call** in V3: apollo-tier extraction (incl. T5), identity disambiguation, LinkedIn candidate picking, smart fields, Tier 0b field mapping. ~25 failures per enrichment run, each behind its own swallow. **Deliberately not fixed here** — reviving T5 would start writing funding that bypasses grounding. **Production likely affected** (same default deployment).
2. **Relevance gap.** `grounding` proves provenance and the critic proves support; neither judges whether a value *answers the field's question*. `funding_stage: "Series F"` grounds against a quote saying *"largest funding round"* when the field asks for *most recent*.
3. Legacy `resolveTopId` returns `candidates[0]` with no identity check (5 non-V3 routes).
4. T5 fills funding under `tier: 'apollo'`, bypassing grounding.
5. Sibling copies only downgrade `source === 'web_search'`, so an `api`-sourced wrong value copies as trusted `crm-history`.

## Companion PR

Customer portal — renders the grounding badges. Ship together.

title: Surface v0 API error detail and stop landing-page generation from hanging (ENG-160)
body:
## What was wrong
Since ~Jun 29, landing-page generation and v0-based edits failed with a bare 'fetch failed' (ENG-135) or a bare 'HTTP 422' with no detail (ENG-159), and some builds hung with no output or error (ENG-158). A production scan of AW-LandingPages confirmed every recent failure was 'fetch failed' at iterations:0 (the v0 API call).

Root cause: Node's global fetch (undici) throws a bare 'TypeError: fetch failed' and stashes the real reason (Connect Timeout / ECONNREFUSED / ENOTFOUND / TLS, often an AggregateError) on error.cause. v0Service persisted only error.message, discarding the actual reason. There was also no per-attempt ceiling, so a v0 request that connected but never responded waited up to undici's 15-min headersTimeout — an effective hang.

## What I changed (backend/src/services/v0Service.ts)
- Added describeError(): walks message -> code -> cause -> AggregateError.errors and joins the distinct pieces so the underlying reason is always surfaced.
- Added withTimeout() and bounded each withRetry attempt to 5 min, so a stuck call fails loudly with a clear, retryable timeout instead of hanging.
- withRetry now uses the unwrapped detail for the retry decision and mutates the thrown error's message, so callers persist/return the real reason — never a bare 'fetch failed' or '422'.

Note: if the upstream cause is v0 credit/quota exhaustion, refilling it is an ops action; this change ensures the failure is always surfaced clearly and loudly rather than as a bare error or a hang.

## How verified
TDD: wrote 7 failing tests first, then implemented. Targeted jest run passes 20/20; related v0Service suites pass 167/167; npx tsc is clean.

title: Fix coding_agent 422 on every edit when preview branch is missing (ENG-159)
body:
What was wrong: The coding_agent preflight (resetReusablePreviewBranchToMain) resets the reusable draft/agentweb-preview branch to main before every run using GitHub's Update-a-reference API (PATCH /git/refs/heads/<branch>). GitHub reports an absent ref as HTTP 422 'Reference does not exist', not 404. The reset only fell through to create the branch on a 404, so for any healthy landing page whose draft branch had never been created, the 422 was rethrown as a bare 'Request failed with status code 422'. Since this runs before the edit loop, it blocked every edit — even a minimal one — with zero detail about the rejected field, exactly matching the report. (The user's GitHub 'Bad credentials' is unrelated: the reset uses the org token.)

What changed (backend/src/services/codingAgentService.ts):
- Added _isMissingGithubRefError(): a missing ref is 404 OR a 422 whose body says 'does not exist'/'not found'. The reset now creates the branch in both cases.
- Added _describeGithubError(): extracts status + message (and nested errors[]) from the axios/GitHub response so genuine failures surface the real validation detail instead of 'Request failed with status code 422'. Applied to the main-ref read, ref update, and ref create calls.

How verified: npx tsc clean; npx jest src/__tests__/codingAgentService.test.ts passes 98/98, including 11 new tests. Integration tests confirm a 422 'Reference does not exist' now creates the branch and the run succeeds, and a genuine 422 fails with the actual GitHub detail in the message. title: Prevent zombie landing-page builds from wedging retries on 'still building' (ENG-158)
body:
What was wrong: When a landing-page build's owning process dies (redeploy/crash) before the 10-minute run timeout fires, the record is left stuck in a 'generating'/'deploying' status without the awaitingReconnect flag. The redeploy poller only sweeps flagged records, so it never cleans the zombie up, and findInFlightJobForSession treated any in-flight record as a live build. Every subsequent request in that session then short-circuited to the 'still building' message and never kicked off a new build — the user waited indefinitely with no page, link, or error (matching the reported 'No tasks have been run in this session yet').

What changed: findInFlightJobForSession now ignores in-flight records older than a shared STUCK_CEILING_MS (30 min, extracted from the poller and exported so both agree on when an in-flight build is dead). Past that age no live process can own the record, so a fresh build is allowed to start instead of reconnecting to a dead one. The timeout-handler reconnect path is unaffected (its build is always ~10 min old).

How verified: Added tests proving the zombie is skipped while a genuinely in-flight build within the ceiling is still reconnected; updated the poller test mock for the shared constant. npx tsc passes and both durable landing test files pass (22/22).

title: fix: inject deterministic UTM attribution capture into generated landing pages
body:
## Summary
- v0-generated landing pages never captured or forwarded UTM/first-touch attribution to the CRM, so leads created through those pages had no source attribution.
- Root cause: the v0 generation prompt only asked v0 to build a form + capture proxy; it never mentioned UTMs, and the scaffold injected no attribution code. Relying on an LLM to include this deterministically was never going to be reliable.
- Fix: for every newly-generated repo, deterministically inject a platform-owned `middleware.ts` (stamps a first-touch cookie from UTM/click-id query params) and `app/api/capture/route.ts` (reads that cookie server-side, forwards it as a top-level `attribution` field — matching what the backend's `normalizeAttribution` actually reads, not `customFields`). Any v0-authored capture route or middleware is force-dropped first via path normalization (handles `src/app/`, route-group variants like `(marketing)`, nested groups) so ours are authoritative — no conflicting-route build errors.
- Added a defense-in-depth guard (`assertNoDuplicateInjectedRoutes`) that throws at generation time if a duplicate route somehow survives the filter, instead of failing silently at Vercel build time later.
- Bonus fix: provisions the missing `AW-ContactEvents` DynamoDB table via `ensureCriticalTables` (was defined and used but never provisioned — writes were silently swallowed).

## Scope / what this does NOT fix
- Landing pages already deployed before this change are untouched and will keep leaking un-attributed leads until migrated separately.
- Historical un-attributed leads are not recoverable.

## Test plan
- [x] 165/165 backend tests pass (`services.v0Service.test.ts`, `ensureCriticalTables.test.ts`), including new tests for path-normalization edge cases (`src/app/`, nested route groups, false-positive helper files) and the duplicate-route guard (both throw and no-throw paths)
- [x] 100% statement/branch/function coverage on all new code (verified via scoped coverage run)
- [x] `npx tsc --noEmit` clean
- [x] **Live-verified end-to-end on a real test environment**: fresh account → real v0 generation → real GitHub repo created under `AgentWebPro` → confirmed injected `middleware.ts` + `app/api/capture/route.ts` byte-for-byte correct in the pushed repo → real Vercel deployment → hit the live URL with `?utm_source=...&gclid=...` → submitted the form → confirmed the resulting lead in `Dev-AW-Leads` has correct `firstTouch`/`lastTouch`/`utmSource`/`utmMedium`

title: Surface LinkedIn account-level invitation throttle on send-invite (ENG-126)
body:
What was wrong: When a LinkedIn account hits its invitation cap (weekly limit, much lower on non-Premium accounts and shrinking as the pending backlog grows), Unipile returns 'Cannot resend yet' for send-invite on EVERY recipient — including brand-new ones. The agentMode linkedinOutreach handler surfaced that phrase verbatim, which reads like a per-recipient cooldown. The agent therefore moved to the next fresh recipient and repeated, burning 10+ attempts per session (failedFunctions linkedin_outreach:10 in the reported session) while sending zero invites and reporting nothing actionable.

What changed: In backend/src/services/agentModeService.ts, the linkedinOutreach catch block now detects 'Cannot resend yet' on the send-invite action and returns an account-level throttle result: it labels the limit as account-wide (not per-recipient), instructs the agent to stop sending and report the invitation limit + pending backlog proactively, and suggests withdrawing stale invitations (list-sent-invitations then cancel-invitation) or queueing for a later run. It sets accountThrottled:true and keeps the raw 'Cannot resend yet' phrase in the body so toolErrorClassifier still classifies it as upstream_rejected. Other actions (e.g. send-message) are unaffected.

How verified: Added a failing unit test first (TDD), then the fix. Ran the outreach test file (43/43 pass), the classifier test (pass, classification unchanged), and npx tsc (clean).

title: feat(tooling): Linear → Claude auto-bug-fix poller (.linear-autofix)
body:
## Summary

Adds `.linear-autofix/` — a self-contained poller that watches Linear for new `Bug` issues and drives an end-to-end automated fix pipeline via `claude -p`:

1. **Poll** Linear for new Bug issues (filtered to Harshit/Manan/Anurag) and run a fixability gate — bugs blocked on external actions are held in Todo with an `autofix:blocked` triage label.
2. **Fix** in an isolated git worktree with a 2h budget, scoped tests, and Opus escalation for heavy bugs; the fixer gets read-only prod data access for root-cause investigation.
3. **Review gate** — multi-agent reviewers (run sequentially to flatten load spikes on the 16GB runner) must approve before proceeding; failures loop back through a refix prompt.
4. **Deterministic checks** (tsc, tests) with gated retries.
5. **Browser verify** — preflight-gated Playwright session against a live preview (vite build+preview, watcher-free, port-per-portal behind a keep-alive proxy on nip.io); recordings are condensed to changed frames and embedded in the Linear report alongside screenshots.
6. **Triage + PR** — green/manual/rework label on the Linear issue, three structured Linear comments, and a draft PR with the fix.

Also includes a human `revise:` loop (comment on the Linear issue to send the fix back with instructions), GC/retention policy for previews (the actual fix for the runner stalls), crash-safe parallel polling, and EC2 deploy scripts + runbook.

## Safety rails

- Fixes run **only** on the dedicated EC2 runner (`AUTOFIX_RUN_ENABLED=1` gate); the poller is inert elsewhere.
- Cron is **not** enabled — runs are started manually while the loop is being iterated on.
- No product code is touched: all 27 files are new and live under `.linear-autofix/`.

## Test plan

- End-to-end validated on ENG-129 (2026-07-02): fix produced, browser-verified with recording, triage green, draft PR #2004 opened.
- CI on this PR: backend/portal jobs are unaffected since the diff contains no `backend/` or `partner-portal/` changes.

title: fix(linkedin-ads): correct account-access error guidance and Conversation Ad payload bug
body:
## Summary

Two independent bugs found while investigating a reported LinkedIn Ads campaign deployment failure for a customer (ThinkingAI, ad account `521460657`):

- **Misleading error guidance on account-access failures.** LinkedIn rejects write calls (`CAMPAIGN`/`CAMPAIGN_GROUP`/`CREATIVE`/etc. `CREATE`/`UPDATE`) with `"Your application is not configured to access the related advertiser account(s)..."` when an ad account hasn'''t been added to AgentWeb'''s single shared LinkedIn Developer Portal app'''s Ad Accounts allowlist (LinkedIn'''s Developer access tier requires this per-account, app-side). Without any handling, Emma had no way to distinguish this from a customer-fixable issue and improvised instructions telling the customer to check "their" LinkedIn Developer Portal — which doesn'''t exist for them, since every customer shares one AgentWeb-owned app. `makeRequest()` in `linkedInAdsService.ts` now rewrites this specific error with accurate guidance (it'''s an AgentWeb-side gap, contact support) before it reaches the model. `toolErrorClassifier.ts` also now classifies it as `'''auth'''` instead of falling into the generic error bucket, for better failure-clustering telemetry.
- **Conversation Ad creation always failed.** `createConversationAd()` sent a `name` field to LinkedIn'''s `POST /rest/conversationAds`, but LinkedIn'''s `SponsoredConversation` schema has no `name` field — only an optional `headlineText`. Every Conversation Ad creation attempt failed outright with `"ERROR :: /name :: unrecognized field found but not allowed"`, for every customer, independent of the permission issue above. Now maps `name`/`headline_text` to `headlineText` and no longer requires it (LinkedIn treats it as optional, falling back to the first message as the headline). Also updated `emma/tools.ts` tool-schema docs so the model isn'''t told `name` is required.

Both root causes were confirmed against real production session data and verified live against LinkedIn'''s API, not guessed at.

## Test plan

- [x] TDD followed: new/updated tests written first and confirmed failing against the old code, then passing after the fix
- [x] `npx tsc` — clean compile
- [x] Full backend suite: 915/916 test suites, 14902/14905 tests passing (pre-existing 1 skipped suite / 3 skipped tests, unrelated)
- [x] Live-verified against a real LinkedIn Ads account (`521460657`, now allowlisted) in the cloud test environment: read access, write access (safe no-op probe), and the corrected container build all confirmed
- [ ] Manual: build a Conversation Ad end-to-end via Agent Mode chat against a real connected account and confirm it succeeds (safe to do now that write access is confirmed working)

title: Add timeout and retry to LinkedIn profile lookups to prevent indefinite hangs (ENG-144)
body:
What was wrong: LinkedIn profile lookups (getLinkedInProfile/getProfile) call the Unipile SDK's request.send, whose fetch has no timeout. When the upstream LinkedIn session is stuck (CAPTCHA/auth wall or a dead browser session), the request never settles and blocks the agent for minutes — the ENG-144 session waited 167s and returned no data (goalCompletion=1).

What changed: Added a shared fetchProfileFromUnipile helper wrapping the Unipile call in a 30s internal timeout (withTimeout) with a single automatic retry on timeout. On timeout, a clear TIMEOUT_ERROR-classified error is surfaced quickly so the agent can explain and offer a retry instead of stalling; non-timeout API errors (404/401/etc.) still bubble up immediately with no wasteful retry. handleError now preserves the TIMEOUT_ERROR classification. Both profile-lookup methods route through the helper; the timer is unref'd and always cleared.

How verified: Added 3 targeted tests (hung-then-retry succeeds; both hang → rejects with TIMEOUT_ERROR; non-timeout error not retried). Full linkedInOutreachService.test.ts suite (103 tests) passes and npx tsc compiles clean.

title: feat: Slack ship-notification in customer's own channel when their feature request / bug resolves (ENG-170)
body:
## Risk: Medium | Priority: High

## What was wrong (before)
When a customer's reported item shipped, notification was email-only: bugs via the Linear resolve-bridge (Resend email per reporter), feature requests via Featurebase's native upvoter email. Customers who work with us through a dedicated Slack channel (the `slackChannels` mapping already on their user record) never heard about it where they actually talk to us.

## What this fixes (after)
Marking an item Done now ALSO pings the reporter in their own Slack channel:
- **Feature requests** — new signed webhook `POST /api/integrations/featurebase/webhook` consumes Featurebase `post.updated` → status `completed` events and notifies the post author + voters.
- **Bugs** — the existing Linear resolve-bridge (`notifyCanonicalResolved`) additionally pings each reporter's channel beside the Resend email.
- Channel = first of the existing personal → org → org-owner resolution (`getEffectiveAllowedChannels`, moved unchanged from `emma/slackMessageTools` into `slackService`). Email remains the always-on baseline; the notifier never throws.

**Ships dark**: the endpoint is a no-op until `FEATUREBASE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is set (see Rollout below). Signature = HMAC-SHA256 over `${timestamp}.${rawBody}`, ±300s freshness, timing-safe compare.

**Hardening from adversarial review** (commit f10d3250):
1. Slack injection: user-generated post titles are escaped (`&<>`) and non-plain-http(s) URLs dropped — a public post titled `<!channel> … <evil|x>` can't broadcast-ping or smuggle disguised links into customers' channels.
2. The webhook 200s immediately and fans out detached — a slow fan-out (rate-limited Slack calls per recipient) can't trip Featurebase's delivery timeout into a concurrent retry (= duplicate pings, eventual webhook auto-suspension).
3. Idempotency is an atomic DynamoDB string-set claim (`settingsService.claimSetMember`, ADD + UPDATED_OLD, no read-modify-write) taken BEFORE the send; a failed send releases the claim so delivery retries re-attempt.

## Live E2E — PASSED (2026-07-02, test env i-0e18650e47317b5a7)

Real chain exercised, no mocks: canary Featurebase post (`integrations.linear`) → synced Linear issue ENG-174 marked **Done** → Featurebase flipped the post Completed → real signed webhook delivery → test env backend → **Slack ping in the mapped channel in ~4 seconds**.

- ✅ One message, correct title + post link, in the reporter's mapped channel (#swarm-digest, bot Emma, 16:14:50Z)
- ✅ `<!channel>` injection probe in the post title arrived ESCAPED — no broadcast fired (verified against raw stored text)
- ✅ Re-completing the same item → delivery received (200) but NO duplicate ping (atomic claim held)
- ✅ Unsigned request → 401; endpoint dark (`ignored: not configured`) without the secret
- ✅ Slack-failure path exercised for real (stale env token → `invalid_auth`): endpoint still 200'd, claim released for retry, no crash
- 🐛 **Live-caught bug, fixed in `e2067f84`**: Featurebase sends status changes as DOTTED fields (`status.type`…), not a bare `status` — the original filter silently no-op'd. Captured the real payload, fixed, re-verified live.
- 📌 Featurebase webhook timeout is **5s** (webhook object `timeoutMs`) — confirms the immediate-200 + detached fan-out design is required.
- 🧹 Canary fully torn down (webhooks, post, issue, channel mapping). Test env left running for your manual sign-off.
- ⚠️ Ops: `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` in the `agentweb/test-env` secret is stale (`invalid_auth`) — worth refreshing.

## Behavioral assertions verified (ENG-170 contract → tests)
1. *Mapped channel + feature request completed → exactly one Slack message with title + link* → `shipNotifyService.test.ts` ("ONE post to the FIRST channel"), `integrations.featurebaseWebhook.test.ts` (completed event → fan-out), claim tests.
2. *Bug reporter with channel → BOTH email AND Slack; ticket still flips* → `intakeService.test.ts` ("pings each reporter on Slack beside the email").
3. *No mapped channel → behavior identical to today* → `shipNotifyService.test.ts` ("no_channel — email-only behavior preserved"; claim not even taken).
4. *Same item completed twice → no double-post* → claim tests (`already_sent`, atomic winner) + `settingsService.setMembers.test.ts`.
5. *Opt-out (`slackShipNotifyDisabled`) → email only* → `shipNotifyService.test.ts` ("opt-out").
6. *Slack failure never blocks email/ticket flip* → `intakeService.test.ts` ("Slack notifier blowing up does not block…"), notifier never-throws tests.

## How to test (once webhook is configured — see Rollout)
1. Log in as a user whose record has a `slackChannels` entry (or set one via `PUT /api/admin/users/:userId/slack-channel`).
2. File a feature request via Emma ("I want a feature where…") — confirm the public post appears on agentweb.featurebase.app.
3. In Featurebase (or via the synced Linear issue), mark the post **Completed**.
4. **Expected**: within seconds, one Slack message in that user's channel: "🎉 Shipped: *{title}* — A feature you requested is now live" + post link.
5. Mark the post back to In Review, then Completed again. **Expected**: no second Slack message (idempotency claim).
6. For bugs: file a bug via Emma, mark the canonical Linear issue Done. **Expected**: reporter gets the existing Resend email AND a "✅ Resolved" Slack ping.

## Edge cases to check
- A post titled with Slack markup (`<!channel>`, `<url|label>`) renders escaped, no broadcast ping (covered by unit test; worth one live look).
- User with no channel mapping: email-only, nothing logged as an error.

## Test evidence
- Full backend suite: 14,976 passed / 0 failed (917 suites; re-run after hardening as merge gate).
- New/updated: 85 tests across `shipNotifyService.test.ts` (new), `integrations.featurebaseWebhook.test.ts` (new), `settingsService.setMembers.test.ts` (new), `intakeService.test.ts`, `emma.slackMessageTools.test.ts` (mock now spreads `requireActual` so the moved resolver stays real).
- `npx tsc` clean.
- Adversarial review workflow: 3 lenses (correctness/concurrency, security, behavior-preservation), findings independently verified, all confirmed items fixed in f10d3250.

## Files changed
- `backend/src/services/shipNotifyService.ts` (new) — never-throw notifier + feature-request fan-out
- `backend/src/routes/integrations.ts` — Featurebase webhook (signed, dark until secret set)
- `backend/src/services/intakeService.ts` — Slack ping in the resolve-bridge reporter loop
- `backend/src/services/slackService.ts` — channel resolver moved in from emma/slackMessageTools (behavior-preserving)
- `backend/src/services/settingsService.ts` — atomic `claimSetMember`/`releaseSetMember`
- `backend/src/services/featurebaseService.ts` — `getPost`, `listPostVoters`
- `backend/src/services/db.ts` — `slackShipNotifyDisabled` user field
- `backend/src/app.ts` — raw-body mount for the new webhook
- `backend/src/emma/slackMessageTools.ts` — imports the moved resolver
- 4 test files, `dev.md` (assumptions to validate on first live webhook)

## What was NOT tested
- The **bug path live** (Linear webhook → resolve bridge → Slack beside email) — unit-tested end to end with mocks, and it reuses the exact notifier that just passed the live feature-path E2E, but no live bug canary was run.
- Voters/multi-recipient fan-out live — the canary had a single recipient; multi-voter fan-out is unit-tested only. Voter lists >100 (single page, warns on truncation).
- Slack Connect auto-provisioned channels (`SLACK_CONNECT_ENABLED` is off; only the `slackChannels` mapping path is exercised live; org fallback unit-tested).
- Opt-out flag live (unit-tested).
- No release-notes entry (`user-release.ts`) — deferred to the deploy flow.

## Rollout (Session: Creds — ~5 min, Harsha)
1. Merge + deploy backend.
2. Featurebase dashboard → Settings → Advanced → Webhooks → create webhook: URL `https://api.agentweb.pro/api/integrations/featurebase/webhook`, topic `post.updated`, version nova.
3. Copy the `whsec_…` secret into the backend env as `FEATUREBASE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (EB console or .ebextensions secret path), restart.
4. Run the How-to-test flow above once.

## Rollback
- Kill switch without deploy: unset `FEATUREBASE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (endpoint goes dark) — bug-path Slack pings stop only via revert.
- Full revert: `git revert -m 1 <merge-commit>` on main; no data migration involved (settings markers + user field are additive and inert).

- Customer Portal: none (no UI surface in this slice; self-service channel settings is a follow-up)

- Linear: ENG-170 (https://linear.app/emmabyaw/issue/ENG-170)

title: feat: OpenRouter unified LLM gateway — admin-gated first slice (ENG-9)

## Risk: Medium | Priority: High

Linear: [ENG-9 — OpenRouter: route LLM calls via OpenRouter](https://linear.app/emmabyaw/issue/ENG-9/openrouter-route-llm-calls-via-openrouter-stop-direct-provider-calls)

## What was wrong (before)
Every LLM provider (Bedrock, Azure, Vertex, Gemini) is a separate hand-wired integration; adding a model means provider-specific plumbing, and there is no way to burn the OpenRouter YC credits ($5k + $0 BYOK fees, Bookface #3222). Separately — surfaced by review during this work — `adminOnly` on registry models was only a model-picker display filter: `/generate`, `updateSessionLlmModel`, and the **unauthenticated** shared-link endpoint all accepted adminOnly model ids straight from the request body.

## What this fixes (after)
OpenRouter is a first-class, OpenAI-compatible provider in `agentModeService`: model ids containing `/` (OpenRouter slugs, e.g. `anthropic/claude-opus-4.8`) route to a lazy singleton client (key: `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` env → Secrets Manager `{env}/AgentWeb/OpenRouter`, created in dev+prod). Five frontier slugs registered `adminOnly` for staged rollout. Any settings-driven model getter (dedup judge, reports, scheduled chats, …) can now be pointed at a slug with zero further wiring. `adminOnly` is now enforced at the point of use on all three request boundaries.

title: Preserve unpublished sequential coding_agent edits on the shared preview branch (ENG-176)
body:
What was wrong: resetReusablePreviewBranchToMain() force-reset draft/agentweb-preview to main at the start of every coding_agent run. When a page had an unpublished edit from an earlier run (e.g. the first book card), the next run wiped the branch back to main before applying its own change, discarding the earlier edit. Both runs therefore captured the same baseCommitSha (main HEAD), and after publish only the last edit survived (ENG-176).

What changed: Added _previewBranchCommitsAheadOfMain(), which uses GitHub's compare API (main...draft/agentweb-preview) to count commits the preview branch is ahead of main. resetReusablePreviewBranchToMain() now skips the force-reset when the branch is ahead (unpublished edits present) and layers the new edit on top; it only resets when the branch is absent or fully published (not ahead). The helper returns 0 on 404 (branch missing) and fails open to 0 on transient compare errors, so edits are never wedged and the existing ENG-159 missing-ref create path is preserved.

title: [codex] Add user funnel status triage
body:
## Risk: Medium | Priority: High

**Single full-scope PR** — user funnel status + Linear-side triage enrichment. (Originally #2025 + stacked #2031; combined 2026-07-07 per Harsha, branch fast-forwarded, #2031 closed.)

Linear: [ENG-187](https://linear.app/emmabyaw/issue/ENG-187/sync-user-funnel-status-into-linear-and-featurebase-triage) · rules: [How this board works — Engineering](https://linear.app/emmabyaw/document/how-this-board-works-engineering-f839303e110c) · backfill: [ENG-221](https://linear.app/emmabyaw/issue/ENG-221/backfill-user-funnelstatus-from-the-pipeline-sheet-after-pr-2025)

## What was wrong (before)
Engineering had no way to tell WHO a bug/feature came from in pipeline terms: no funnel status on users, and intake created Linear bug canonicals with only `Bug` + `Customer Reported` — unprioritized, unassigned, rotting in Backlog. Feature requests synced from Featurebase landed with only the `Featurebase` label. `linearService` silently dropped unresolvable label names.

## What this fixes (after)
Three layers, one flow:

1. **Funnel status on users (manual by design)** — `funnelStatus` field on the User model, `PATCH /api/admin/users/:id/funnel-status` admin endpoint, and a Partner Portal Users-table dropdown with the 12 pipeline-tracker stages (Follow-up → Paid / Retention Handoff, Parked). No codified stage-transition checkpoints yet — the weekly pipeline-sheet ritual stays the source of truth; the dropdown mirrors it without code changes. Shared stage→label/tag mapping in `utils/userFunnelStatus.ts`.
2. **Bug intake enrichment + no-rot defaults** — bug canonicals get the reporter's stage labels (`Status: <stage>` + coarse `Sales/Setup/Activated/Retention/Parked`), priority from the ladder (Retention→Urgent, Setup/Activated→High, else Medium), state **Todo**, default assignee **Harshit**. Dedup unions stage labels and raises (never lowers) priority.
3. **Feature-request enrichment (webhook)** — FB-synced Linear issues get stage labels + `Needs PM`, settled in **Backlog**, no auto-priority/assignee.

Funnel info is **internal only**: scrubbed from all Featurebase-bound content and reporter-facing email; it exists solely as Linear labels + private eng context.

## Behavioral contract coverage (ENG-187 comment "Design settled + behavioral contract (Harsha, 2026-07-07)")

| # | Assertion | Verified by (test name, file) |
|---|-----------|-------------------------------|
| 1 | Retention-stage bug → `Bug`,`Customer Reported`,`Status: Paid / Retention Handoff`,`Retention`; Urgent; Todo; Harshit | `Paid / Retention Handoff reporter -> Bug + Customer Reported + stage labels, Urgent, Todo, Harshit` — `intakeService.funnelTriage.test.ts` |
| 2 | Trial-stage bug (Account Setup → Payment Conversion) → stage labels; High | `Account Setup reporter -> stage labels + High` and `Payment Conversion reporter (end of the trial range) -> stage labels + High` — `intakeService.funnelTriage.test.ts` |
| 3 | Missing/unknown funnel → still Todo + default assignee + Medium (never unassigned/unprioritized) | `MISSING funnel status -> still Todo + default assignee + Medium, base labels only` and `UNKNOWN funnel status value -> …` — `intakeService.funnelTriage.test.ts` |
| 4 | Feature request → Linear issue in Backlog with stage labels + `Needs PM`; no auto-priority, no auto-assignee | `known author with a funnel stage -> stage labels + "Needs PM", settled in Backlog, NO priority, NO assignee` (+ 8 more resolution/degradation cases) — `intakeService.featureEnrichment.test.ts`; webhook seam: `Issue create with the Featurebase label -> enrichment with issue id + title` (+ non-FB/update/drift/error routing) — `integrations.linearWebhook.test.ts`; Backlog settle semantics: `settleStateName (ENG-187 contract #4)` block — `linearService.test.ts`; post→author join: `findPostByTitle` block — `featurebaseService.test.ts` |
| 5 | Zero funnel leakage: no funnel/stage string in Featurebase ticket/post content or reporter-facing email, asserted on payloads | `bug: the Featurebase TICKET creation payload carries no funnel/stage string`, `feature request: the Featurebase POST creation payload …`, `… PRIVATE Featurebase eng note is scrubbed …`, `feature request dedup: the stacked private comment is scrubbed too`, `reporter-facing resolve email carries no funnel/stage string` — `intakeService.funnelTriage.test.ts`; enrichment path only READS Featurebase: `privacy (contract #5): enrichment only READS Featurebase — no FB write surface is ever called` — `intakeService.featureEnrichment.test.ts` |
| 6 | Dedup upgrade: higher-tier reporter unions stage labels + raises priority; never lowered | `a paying (Retention) reporter on an existing canonical -> unions stage labels + raises to Urgent` — `intakeService.funnelTriage.test.ts`; raise-only invariant: `NEVER lowers priority: Urgent(1) canonical + Medium(3) reporter -> priority untouched`, `unions new stage labels … raises Medium(3) -> Urgent(1)`, `treats priority 0 (None) as the floor` — `linearService.test.ts` |
| 7 | Label resolution is loud: dropped label → error log naming it | `logs an error NAMING each label that fails to resolve (no silent drops)` (+ state fallback variant, + `unknown settle-state name -> LOUD error naming it`) — `linearService.test.ts`; resolution-chain misses are loud too: post-not-found / user-not-found / FB-down cases — `intakeService.featureEnrichment.test.ts`; payload contract drift: `labelIds but NO expanded labels array -> loud error, no silent skip` — `integrations.linearWebhook.test.ts` |

Call-site threading (reporter's `funnelStatus` actually reaches the intake seam): `support.reportUiBug.funnelThreading.test.ts`, `emma.reportProductIssues.funnelThreading.test.ts`.

## Feature-request seam (contract #4) — how it works
Feature requests never become Linear issues in this repo: `intakeService.fileFeatureRequest` creates a public **Featurebase post** (`integrations.linear:true`) and the linked Linear issue is created ~10s later by **Featurebase's FB→Linear sync inside their SaaS**. The enrichment seam is therefore the existing Linear webhook (`routes/integrations.ts`, same route as the resolve bridge, HMAC verification unchanged): on an Issue **create** event whose expanded `labels` include `Featurebase` (verified marker — every FB-synced issue on the board carries it, and `createInternalLinearIssue` never attaches it), `intakeService.enrichFeaturebaseSyncedIssue` runs:

1. **Author resolution**: synced issue title → `featurebaseService.findPostByTitle` (exact case/whitespace-insensitive match on the verified `GET /v2/posts?q=` search; zero or multiple matches → null, because attributing the *wrong* author's stage is worse than none; falls back to `getPost` when the search result omits the author) → author email → `userDb.getUserByEmail` → `funnelStatus`. Chosen over parsing the Linear attachment ("Featurebase Submission" URL) because the attachment is added by the sync *after* issue creation (race at webhook time) and carries only a slug with no verified slug-fetch API; the title is copied verbatim onto the issue and the post exists *before* the issue by construction. This also covers posts created directly on the public board (not just via our intake).
2. **Enrichment**: `raiseIssueTriage(issueId, { addLabelNames: [...stageTags, 'Needs PM'], settleStateName: 'Backlog' })` — labels union (retry-idempotent), state settles to Backlog only from pre-work states (`triage`/`unstarted`); an issue a human already advanced is never yanked back. NO priority, NO assignee by design.
3. **Degradation is loud, never fatal**: unknown post / unknown user / FB API down → `Needs PM` alone + `console.error` naming the issue; only a hard failure applying labels propagates (route catches → 200 + log, so the resolve bridge is never taken down). Non-Featurebase issue creations fall through untouched.

Both the `Needs PM` and `Featurebase` labels were verified live in the ENG team before hardcoding (ids `a50a944a…`, `cb59fa7b…`).

## How to test
1. Set a test user's funnel status to `Paid / Retention Handoff` (Partner Portal admin dropdown from #2025, or `PATCH /api/admin/users/:id/funnel-status`).
2. As that user, open the in-app "Report a bug" button and file a bug (`FEATUREBASE_INTAKE=true` env).
3. **Expected**: a new Linear ENG issue exists with labels `Bug`, `Customer Reported`, `Status: Paid / Retention Handoff`, `Retention`; priority **Urgent**; state **Todo**; assignee **Harshit Shah**.
4. Open the reporter's Featurebase ticket (their "My profile" card) and the internal team email.
5. **Expected**: neither the ticket content nor any reporter-visible surface mentions funnel/stage/status; the Linear issue description's private context block does.
6. As a second user with no funnel status set, file a very similar bug (dedup should group it).
7. **Expected**: no second Linear issue; the existing canonical gains a `[reporter-ticket #N]` comment and keeps its Urgent priority (never lowered).
8. Clear a user's funnel status entirely and file a bug.
9. **Expected**: canonical still lands in **Todo**, assigned to Harshit, priority **Medium**.
10. As the Retention-stage user, file a **feature request** (Emma `report_product_issues` type `feature_request`, or post directly on the Featurebase board) and wait ~30s for the FB→Linear sync + webhook.
11. **Expected**: the synced Linear issue (it carries the `Featurebase` label + "Featurebase Submission" attachment) also carries `Status: Paid / Retention Handoff`, `Retention`, `Needs PM`; state **Backlog**; **no** priority; **no** assignee. The Featurebase post itself shows nothing funnel-related.
12. File a feature request from an email with no AgentWeb account (directly on the board).
13. **Expected**: the synced issue gets only `Needs PM`; backend error log names the unresolved author; webhook returns 200.

## Edge cases to check
- A stage label deleted from the Linear ENG team: the issue is still created (minus that label) and the backend error log names the dropped label (`[linear] label "…" does not exist in team ENG`).
- Two open Featurebase posts with the exact same title: enrichment refuses to guess (logs, applies `Needs PM` only) rather than attributing the wrong reporter's stage.

## Test evidence
- `npx tsc --noEmit` (backend/): clean.
- New (contract #4): `npx jest src/__tests__/integrations.linearWebhook.test.ts src/__tests__/intakeService.featureEnrichment.test.ts src/__tests__/featurebaseService.test.ts src/__tests__/linearService.test.ts` → 4 suites, **65 passed, 0 failed** (29 new tests: 10 webhook-route, 9 enrichment, 6 findPostByTitle, 4 settleStateName; all written first and failing before implementation).
- Regression: `npx jest integrations src/__tests__/intakeService.test.ts src/__tests__/intakeService.funnelTriage.test.ts src/__tests__/support.reportUiBug.funnelThreading.test.ts src/__tests__/support.reportUiBug.test.ts src/__tests__/emma.reportProductIssues.funnelThreading.test.ts src/__tests__/featurebaseIdentity.routes.test.ts src/__tests__/shipNotifyService.test.ts` → 13 suites, **118 passed, 0 failed**.
- Earlier bug-path evidence (unchanged): `intakeService.funnelTriage/linearService/intakeService` → 3 suites, 44 passed; threading suites → 5 suites, 35 passed; `emailService.oncallAlert` + `integrations` → 40 + 33 passed.
- All external boundaries (Linear GraphQL, Featurebase, DB, Resend, dedup LLM) mocked; no live calls in tests.

## Complexity ledger
- Bug path: +~120 impl lines / +~500 test lines. Feature path (contract #4): +~110 impl lines / +~450 test lines. 0 new tables/flags/dependencies/routes — the enrichment rides the EXISTING Linear webhook and the EXISTING `raiseIssueTriage` helper (one new optional param), one new FB read helper (`findPostByTitle`), one new service function. No pending-enrichment store: author resolution is stateless (title→post→user), so nothing to persist, expire, or reconcile across instances.

## Files changed
- `backend/src/services/intakeService.ts` — funnel-derived stage labels + priority/state/assignee defaults on bug canonicals; dedup raise; Featurebase-safe context scrub; NEW `enrichFeaturebaseSyncedIssue` (contract #4)
- `backend/src/routes/integrations.ts` — Linear webhook: Issue-creation branch for FB-synced issues (signature verification + resolve bridge unchanged)
- `backend/src/services/linearService.ts` — loud label/state resolution; `priority`/`stateName`/`assigneeId` on create; `raiseIssueTriage` (+ new `settleStateName`)
- `backend/src/services/featurebaseService.ts` — NEW `findPostByTitle` (exact-match post→author resolution)
- `backend/src/utils/userFunnelStatus.ts` — `getUserFunnelStatusCoarseTag` export
- `backend/src/routes/support.ts`, `backend/src/emma/tools.ts` — thread `funnelStatus` into `fileUserIssue`
- Tests: `intakeService.funnelTriage.test.ts` (new), `intakeService.featureEnrichment.test.ts` (new), `integrations.linearWebhook.test.ts` (new), `support.reportUiBug.funnelThreading.test.ts` (new), `emma.reportProductIssues.funnelThreading.test.ts` (new), `linearService.test.ts`, `featurebaseService.test.ts`, `intakeService.test.ts` (extended)

## What was NOT tested
- No live Linear/Featurebase round-trip — all boundary behavior is mock-asserted; the exact label names (`Needs PM`, `Featurebase`, all `Status: *`/coarse labels) and Harshit's assignee ID were verified against the live workspace via the Linear API before hardcoding, but issue creation/enrichment itself was not exercised live end-to-end (no live FB→Linear sync → webhook → label round-trip).
- `GET /v2/posts?q=` including the `author` field in search results was not re-verified live — the code does not depend on it (falls back to `getPost(id)`, whose author mapping IS the verified contract).
- Linear's Issue-create webhook payload carrying the expanded `labels` array is assumed from the current payload contract (the same expansion the existing resolve bridge relies on for `data.state`); if it drifts, the handler logs a loud contract-drift error rather than silently skipping — but the drift itself has no live repro test.
- The Notion flag-off legacy path with the new `funnelStatus` param (param is ignored there by design; existing flag-off tests still pass).
- Concurrency: two simultaneous reporters racing `raiseIssueTriage` (last-write union; benign because raise-only), and a webhook retry racing a human state change inside the same second (settle only moves pre-work states, so worst case is a no-op).

## Related PRs
- Backend: stacked on #2025 (funnel status field + Partner Portal dropdown)
- Customer Portal: standalone (no frontend changes)

title: Fail Google Ads OAuth with a clear error when the adwords scope isn't granted (ENG-179)
body:
What was wrong: The Google Ads OAuth /finalize route never checked which scopes Google actually granted. When a user completes consent but the sensitive adwords scope is dropped (Google Workspace admin policy restricting third-party apps, or the permission left unchecked on the 'unverified app' consent screen), the token exchange still succeeds with only userinfo scopes. The code then called listAccessibleCustomers with a scope-less token, which fails/returns nothing, so the connection silently ended with 0 connected accounts and an opaque 500. Confirmed against prod: the affected user (healthcare Workspace org) had google_drive connected but no google_ads; the sibling google_drive finalize flow already guards this exact case, google_ads did not.

What changed: (1) backend googleAdsAuth /finalize now parses the granted `scope` from the token response and returns a 422 insufficient_scopes with an actionable message before probing the Google Ads API, mirroring the google_drive flow; (2) the customer-portal Google Ads OAuth callback surfaces that message instead of the raw error code.

How verified: Added backend tests (missing adwords scope, and no scope field at all -> 422, and listAccountHierarchy not called) and a frontend test (422 insufficient_scopes shows the actionable message). Backend jest 15/15 pass, frontend vitest 11/11 pass, npx tsc clean in both repos.

title: Scope agent tool failure breaker per LinkedIn recipient (ENG-182)
body:
What was wrong: The per-run repeated-failure circuit breaker (backend/src/services/agentToolGatewayService.ts) keyed failures on (runId, tool, error-head) only. LinkedIn's 'Cannot resend yet' is an upstream_rejected fast-trip class (threshold 2) and yields an identical error head regardless of recipient, so two already-invited profiles tripped the breaker for linkedin_outreach as a whole and then blocked every subsequent send-invite in the run — including genuinely different recipients that were never individually attempted (the exact symptom in the reported Dream 100 run).

What changed: Added a per-recipient failureScope for LinkedIn write actions (send-invite/send-message/send-inmail/cancel/accept-invitation), derived from profile_url/provider_id and normalized to collapse trailing-slash and tracking-query URL variants. Failure accounting (recordToolFailure/findTrippedFailure) is now isolated per recipient. A refusal for one profile no longer blocks invites to a different profile, while repeated identical failures to the SAME recipient still trip the breaker. All other tools keep a single shared scope, preserving prior behavior (media budgets, cross-run isolation, structured-failure accounting unchanged).

How verified: TDD — the reproduction test fails on the pre-fix code (a third, never-attempted recipient is blocked) and passes after the fix. npx tsc clean; npx jest src/__tests__/agentToolGatewayService.test.ts passes 102/102.

title: fix(intake): render Featurebase content as HTML so Linear-synced feature requests keep structure
body:
## Risk: Low | Priority: Medium ## What was wrong (before) Customer feature requests filed through Emma's `report_product_issues` land in Linear as one giant run-on paragraph (reported on **ENG-204**). It looked like Emma was writing flat text — she wasn't. ## Root cause (verified, not Emma) Emma authors real paragraph structure (the stored Featurebase post for ENG-204 had **39 newlines**). Featurebase's `content` field is **HTML** (their docs: *"content should be formatted as HTML"*). We send Emma's markdown/plaintext with **raw newlines and no block tags**, so Featurebase renders the newlines on its own board (nl2br) but its native `integrations.linear:true` push treats them as insignificant HTML whitespace and **collapses the whole body into one paragraph**. Proof: FB-pushed issues (ENG-204; ENG-166 `"## The ask When a customer…"` — heading newline gone) are blobs, while issues our own code creates via `createInternalLinearIssue` (ENG-151, ENG-205) keep `\n\n` + bullets. Linear stores `\n` faithfully — the flattening is in Featurebase's push. ## What this fixes (after) New `mdToFeaturebaseHtml()` converts the intake layer's markdown/plaintext to HTML block tags, applied at both Featurebase send sites (`createPost`, `createTicket`). Real `

`/`

  • `/`

    ` tags survive **both** the Featurebase render **and** the Linear push. **Why hand-rolled, not `marked`:** the backend is CommonJS and `marked` is ESM-only — a static import risks `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM` at load time (which would break **all** intake, not just formatting), and dynamic-import/jest-ESM plumbing is disproportionate for the handful of constructs Emma/users emit. The converter also **HTML-escapes input first**, so raw user text can't inject markup (no reliance on Featurebase-side sanitization). Native Linear sync is left intact (load-bearing for the resolve→notify-upvoters flow). ## Verified live (the key assumption) Created a hidden (`inReview:true`) test post with HTML content + `integrations.linear:true` and inspected the pushed Linear issue: | Sent to Featurebase | Landed in Linear | |---|---| | `

    …

    ` (two of them) | two paragraphs, `\n\n`-separated ✅ | | `
    • bullet one
    • bullet two
    ` | `* bullet one` / `* bullet two` markdown list ✅ | | `

    …

    ` | plain text on its own line (heading markup dropped — cosmetic) | | `bold` | `bold` (bold dropped — cosmetic) | The **vertical structure that caused the blob is fully preserved.** Test artifacts cleaned up: the Featurebase post was deleted; the throwaway Linear issue **ENG-216** was canceled (MCP can't hard-delete — safe to trash). ## Complexity ledger - **Lines:** +~35 (one self-contained pure function) / −0. No behavior removed. - **Moving parts:** **no new dependency**, no new env var, no new table, native sync untouched. Removes a class of malformed-output bug. - **Behavior:** feature-request + bug-ticket content now renders structured on Featurebase and stays structured through the Linear push. No change to what gets filed, dedup, attribution, or the public/private split. ## How to test 1. In Emma, ask her to file a feature request with a few paragraphs + a bullet list (`report_product_issues`). 2. Open the resulting Featurebase post → **Expected:** headings/paragraphs/bullets render (not a wall of text). 3. Open the synced Linear issue → **Expected:** paragraphs are `\n\n`-separated and bullets are a real list — **not** a single run-on line. ## Tests - `backend/src/__tests__/featurebaseService.test.ts`: new `mdToFeaturebaseHtml` suite (headings, ul/ol, blank-line paragraphs, single-newline `
    `, empty input) + updated `createPost`/`createTicket` to assert HTML content. **75/75 pass** across featurebase + intake suites; `npx tsc` clean. ## What was NOT tested - Exact heading level / bold survival through the Linear push (verified they're cosmetic-only losses, not structural). - End-to-end through a real Emma chat session (unit + a live Featurebase→Linear push were exercised instead). ## Related - Root cause + verification notes added to `dev.md`. - The one-off ENG-204 cleanup (Linear + Featurebase reformatted to clean markup) was done directly, separately from this code change. ## Linear ENG-204 (source report). This PR fixes the mechanism for all future filings.

title: feat: funnel-status triage tags + no-rot defaults on intake (ENG-187)
body:
## Risk: Medium | Priority: Medium

Stacked on #2025 (`codex/user-funnel-status`) — targets that branch and retargets `main` automatically when #2025 merges.

Linear task: [ENG-187 — Sync user funnel status into Linear and FeatureBase triage](https://linear.app/emmabyaw/issue/ENG-187/sync-user-funnel-status-into-linear-and-featurebase-triage)

## What was wrong (before)
PR #2025 put the reporter's funnel status on the user record and into internal context/tags, but nothing reached Linear-side triage: customer-filed bug canonicals were created with only `Bug` + `Customer Reported`, in Backlog, unassigned, no priority — so bugs rotted and couldn't be filtered by customer stage. Feature requests were worse: their Linear issue is created by Featurebase's FB→Linear sync inside their SaaS, so it landed with only the `Featurebase` label — no stage labels, no PM marker. `linearService` also silently dropped any label name that didn't resolve, erasing triage signal with no error.

## What this fixes (after)
Bug canonicals are enriched at report-creation time, Linear-side only: the reporter's stage labels (`Status: <stage>` + coarse `Sales/Setup/Activated/Retention/Parked`) are attached, and every customer bug lands with no-rot defaults — priority from the coarse bucket (Retention→Urgent, Setup/Activated→High, else Medium), state **Todo**, default assignee **Harshit Shah**. Deduped follow-up reporters union their stage labels onto the canonical and raise (never lower) its priority. **Feature requests (contract #4)**: the Linear webhook now handles Issue CREATE events carrying the `Featurebase` label (the FB→Linear sync's marker — our own issues never carry it) and enriches the synced issue with the reporter's stage labels + `Needs PM`, settled in **Backlog** — no auto-priority, no auto-assignee (the weekly PM pass decides). Label/state resolution now logs an error naming every dropped name. Funnel info is scrubbed from all Featurebase-bound content (including private eng notes) and never appears in reporter-facing email.

## Behavioral contract coverage (ENG-187 comment "Design settled + behavioral contract (Harsha, 2026-07-07)")

| # | Assertion | Verified by (test name, file) |
|---|-----------|-------------------------------|
| 1 | Retention-stage bug → `Bug`,`Customer Reported`,`Status: Paid / Retention Handoff`,`Retention`; Urgent; Todo; Harshit | `Paid / Retention Handoff reporter -> Bug + Customer Reported + stage labels, Urgent, Todo, Harshit` — `intakeService.funnelTriage.test.ts` |
| 2 | Trial-stage bug (Account Setup → Payment Conversion) → stage labels; High | `Account Setup reporter -> stage labels + High` and `Payment Conversion reporter (end of the trial range) -> stage labels + High` — `intakeService.funnelTriage.test.ts` |
| 3 | Missing/unknown funnel → still Todo + default assignee + Medium (never unassigned/unprioritized) | `MISSING funnel status -> still Todo + default assignee + Medium, base labels only` and `UNKNOWN funnel status value -> …` — `intakeService.funnelTriage.test.ts` |
| 4 | Feature request → Linear issue in Backlog with stage labels + `Needs PM`; no auto-priority, no auto-assignee | `known author with a funnel stage -> stage labels + "Needs PM", settled in Backlog, NO priority, NO assignee` (+ 8 more resolution/degradation cases) — `intakeService.featureEnrichment.test.ts`; webhook seam: `Issue create with the Featurebase label -> enrichment with issue id + title` (+ non-FB/update/drift/error routing) — `integrations.linearWebhook.test.ts`; Backlog settle semantics: `settleStateName (ENG-187 contract #4)` block — `linearService.test.ts`; post→author join: `findPostByTitle` block — `featurebaseService.test.ts` |
| 5 | Zero funnel leakage: no funnel/stage string in Featurebase ticket/post content or reporter-facing email, asserted on payloads | `bug: the Featurebase TICKET creation payload carries no funnel/stage string`, `feature request: the Featurebase POST creation payload …`, `… PRIVATE Featurebase eng note is scrubbed …`, `feature request dedup: the stacked private comment is scrubbed too`, `reporter-facing resolve email carries no funnel/stage string` — `intakeService.funnelTriage.test.ts`; enrichment path only READS Featurebase: `privacy (contract #5): enrichment only READS Featurebase — no FB write surface is ever called` — `intakeService.featureEnrichment.test.ts` |
| 6 | Dedup upgrade: higher-tier reporter unions stage labels + raises priority; never lowered | `a paying (Retention) reporter on an existing canonical -> unions stage labels + raises to Urgent` — `intakeService.funnelTriage.test.ts`; raise-only invariant: `NEVER lowers priority: Urgent(1) canonical + Medium(3) reporter -> priority untouched`, `unions new stage labels … raises Medium(3) -> Urgent(1)`, `treats priority 0 (None) as the floor` — `linearService.test.ts` |
| 7 | Label resolution is loud: dropped label → error log naming it | `logs an error NAMING each label that fails to resolve (no silent drops)` (+ state fallback variant, + `unknown settle-state name -> LOUD error naming it`) — `linearService.test.ts`; resolution-chain misses are loud too: post-not-found / user-not-found / FB-down cases — `intakeService.featureEnrichment.test.ts`; payload contract drift: `labelIds but NO expanded labels array -> loud error, no silent skip` — `integrations.linearWebhook.test.ts` |

Call-site threading (reporter's `funnelStatus` actually reaches the intake seam): `support.reportUiBug.funnelThreading.test.ts`, `emma.reportProductIssues.funnelThreading.test.ts`.

## Feature-request seam (contract #4) — how it works
Feature requests never become Linear issues in this repo: `intakeService.fileFeatureRequest` creates a public **Featurebase post** (`integrations.linear:true`) and the linked Linear issue is created ~10s later by **Featurebase's FB→Linear sync inside their SaaS**. The enrichment seam is therefore the existing Linear webhook (`routes/integrations.ts`, same route as the resolve bridge, HMAC verification unchanged): on an Issue **create** event whose expanded `labels` include `Featurebase` (verified marker — every FB-synced issue on the board carries it, and `createInternalLinearIssue` never attaches it), `intakeService.enrichFeaturebaseSyncedIssue` runs:

1. **Author resolution**: synced issue title → `featurebaseService.findPostByTitle` (exact case/whitespace-insensitive match on the verified `GET /v2/posts?q=` search; zero or multiple matches → null, because attributing the *wrong* author's stage is worse than none; falls back to `getPost` when the search result omits the author) → author email → `userDb.getUserByEmail` → `funnelStatus`. Chosen over parsing the Linear attachment ("Featurebase Submission" URL) because the attachment is added by the sync *after* issue creation (race at webhook time) and carries only a slug with no verified slug-fetch API; the title is copied verbatim onto the issue and the post exists *before* the issue by construction. This also covers posts created directly on the public board (not just via our intake).
2. **Enrichment**: `raiseIssueTriage(issueId, { addLabelNames: [...stageTags, 'Needs PM'], settleStateName: 'Backlog' })` — labels union (retry-idempotent), state settles to Backlog only from pre-work states (`triage`/`unstarted`); an issue a human already advanced is never yanked back. NO priority, NO assignee by design.
3. **Degradation is loud, never fatal**: unknown post / unknown user / FB API down → `Needs PM` alone + `console.error` naming the issue; only a hard failure applying labels propagates (route catches → 200 + log, so the resolve bridge is never taken down). Non-Featurebase issue creations fall through untouched.

Both the `Needs PM` and `Featurebase` labels were verified live in the ENG team before hardcoding (ids `a50a944a…`, `cb59fa7b…`).

## How to test
1. Set a test user's funnel status to `Paid / Retention Handoff` (Partner Portal admin dropdown from #2025, or `PATCH /api/admin/users/:id/funnel-status`).
2. As that user, open the in-app "Report a bug" button and file a bug (`FEATUREBASE_INTAKE=true` env).
3. **Expected**: a new Linear ENG issue exists with labels `Bug`, `Customer Reported`, `Status: Paid / Retention Handoff`, `Retention`; priority **Urgent**; state **Todo**; assignee **Harshit Shah**.
4. Open the reporter's Featurebase ticket (their "My profile" card) and the internal team email.
5. **Expected**: neither the ticket content nor any reporter-visible surface mentions funnel/stage/status; the Linear issue description's private context block does.
6. As a second user with no funnel status set, file a very similar bug (dedup should group it).
7. **Expected**: no second Linear issue; the existing canonical gains a `[reporter-ticket #N]` comment and keeps its Urgent priority (never lowered).
8. Clear a user's funnel status entirely and file a bug.
9. **Expected**: canonical still lands in **Todo**, assigned to Harshit, priority **Medium**.
10. As the Retention-stage user, file a **feature request** (Emma `report_product_issues` type `feature_request`, or post directly on the Featurebase board) and wait ~30s for the FB→Linear sync + webhook.
11. **Expected**: the synced Linear issue (it carries the `Featurebase` label + "Featurebase Submission" attachment) also carries `Status: Paid / Retention Handoff`, `Retention`, `Needs PM`; state **Backlog**; **no** priority; **no** assignee. The Featurebase post itself shows nothing funnel-related.
12. File a feature request from an email with no AgentWeb account (directly on the board).
13. **Expected**: the synced issue gets only `Needs PM`; backend error log names the unresolved author; webhook returns 200.

## Edge cases to check
- A stage label deleted from the Linear ENG team: the issue is still created (minus that label) and the backend error log names the dropped label (`[linear] label "…" does not exist in team ENG`).
- Two open Featurebase posts with the exact same title: enrichment refuses to guess (logs, applies `Needs PM` only) rather than attributing the wrong reporter's stage.

## Test evidence
- `npx tsc --noEmit` (backend/): clean.
- New (contract #4): `npx jest src/__tests__/integrations.linearWebhook.test.ts src/__tests__/intakeService.featureEnrichment.test.ts src/__tests__/featurebaseService.test.ts src/__tests__/linearService.test.ts` → 4 suites, **65 passed, 0 failed** (29 new tests: 10 webhook-route, 9 enrichment, 6 findPostByTitle, 4 settleStateName; all written first and failing before implementation).
- Regression: `npx jest integrations src/__tests__/intakeService.test.ts src/__tests__/intakeService.funnelTriage.test.ts src/__tests__/support.reportUiBug.funnelThreading.test.ts src/__tests__/support.reportUiBug.test.ts src/__tests__/emma.reportProductIssues.funnelThreading.test.ts src/__tests__/featurebaseIdentity.routes.test.ts src/__tests__/shipNotifyService.test.ts` → 13 suites, **118 passed, 0 failed**.
- Earlier bug-path evidence (unchanged): `intakeService.funnelTriage/linearService/intakeService` → 3 suites, 44 passed; threading suites → 5 suites, 35 passed; `emailService.oncallAlert` + `integrations` → 40 + 33 passed.
- All external boundaries (Linear GraphQL, Featurebase, DB, Resend, dedup LLM) mocked; no live calls in tests.

## Complexity ledger
- Bug path: +~120 impl lines / +~500 test lines. Feature path (contract #4): +~110 impl lines / +~450 test lines. 0 new tables/flags/dependencies/routes — the enrichment rides the EXISTING Linear webhook and the EXISTING `raiseIssueTriage` helper (one new optional param), one new FB read helper (`findPostByTitle`), one new service function. No pending-enrichment store: author resolution is stateless (title→post→user), so nothing to persist, expire, or reconcile across instances.

## Files changed
- `backend/src/services/intakeService.ts` — funnel-derived stage labels + priority/state/assignee defaults on bug canonicals; dedup raise; Featurebase-safe context scrub; NEW `enrichFeaturebaseSyncedIssue` (contract #4)
- `backend/src/routes/integrations.ts` — Linear webhook: Issue-creation branch for FB-synced issues (signature verification + resolve bridge unchanged)
- `backend/src/services/linearService.ts` — loud label/state resolution; `priority`/`stateName`/`assigneeId` on create; `raiseIssueTriage` (+ new `settleStateName`)
- `backend/src/services/featurebaseService.ts` — NEW `findPostByTitle` (exact-match post→author resolution)
- `backend/src/utils/userFunnelStatus.ts` — `getUserFunnelStatusCoarseTag` export
- `backend/src/routes/support.ts`, `backend/src/emma/tools.ts` — thread `funnelStatus` into `fileUserIssue`
- Tests: `intakeService.funnelTriage.test.ts` (new), `intakeService.featureEnrichment.test.ts` (new), `integrations.linearWebhook.test.ts` (new), `support.reportUiBug.funnelThreading.test.ts` (new), `emma.reportProductIssues.funnelThreading.test.ts` (new), `linearService.test.ts`, `featurebaseService.test.ts`, `intakeService.test.ts` (extended)

## What was NOT tested
- No live Linear/Featurebase round-trip — all boundary behavior is mock-asserted; the exact label names (`Needs PM`, `Featurebase`, all `Status: *`/coarse labels) and Harshit's assignee ID were verified against the live workspace via the Linear API before hardcoding, but issue creation/enrichment itself was not exercised live end-to-end (no live FB→Linear sync → webhook → label round-trip).
- `GET /v2/posts?q=` including the `author` field in search results was not re-verified live — the code does not depend on it (falls back to `getPost(id)`, whose author mapping IS the verified contract).
- Linear's Issue-create webhook payload carrying the expanded `labels` array is assumed from the current payload contract (the same expansion the existing resolve bridge relies on for `data.state`); if it drifts, the handler logs a loud contract-drift error rather than silently skipping — but the drift itself has no live repro test.
- The Notion flag-off legacy path with the new `funnelStatus` param (param is ignored there by design; existing flag-off tests still pass).
- Concurrency: two simultaneous reporters racing `raiseIssueTriage` (last-write union; benign because raise-only), and a webhook retry racing a human state change inside the same second (settle only moves pre-work states, so worst case is a no-op).

## Related PRs
- Backend: stacked on #2025 (funnel status field + Partner Portal dropdown)
- Customer Portal: standalone (no frontend changes)

title: Linear webhook: fire customer comms only on the transition into Done (ENG-222)
body:
Originating source: https://fathom.video/calls/738637244?timestamp=713.9999
Linear: https://linear.app/emmabyaw/issue/ENG-222/linear-webhook-fire-customer-comms-only-on-done-and-only-on-the

## Human Bug Report / Ask

Harsha took over ENG-222 from the Argusoft meeting. The bug: the Linear -> customer-comms webhook (`POST /api/integrations/linear/webhook`) could fire customer-facing resolved comms before an issue reached the board's real Done state, and could re-fire comms on later edits while an issue was already Done.

Specifically, the old behavior gated on Linear state category (`completed`) instead of the exact Done state, while the board now uses Merged -> Verifying -> Done and only Done is customer-communicable. It also did not require an actual transition into Done via `updatedFrom.stateId`, so title/label edits on already-Done issues could re-email reporters.

## What Changed

- Gate resolve comms by configured Done state ID (`LINEAR_DONE_STATE_ID`), not state name or category.
- Require an `Issue` `update` event with `updatedFrom.stateId` present and different from Done before firing `notifyCanonicalResolved`.
- Fail loud with `ok:false` when `LINEAR_DONE_STATE_ID` is missing for issue updates.
- Added route-level coverage for the Linear webhook; this route previously had no dedicated tests.
- Updated the handler doc-comment and added the dated `dev.md` note.

## Tests / Checks Run

- Local: `NODE_PATH=/Users/harshmoney/Desktop/AgentWeb/agentweb/backend/node_modules node --max-old-space-size=4096 /Users/harshmoney/Desktop/AgentWeb/agentweb/backend/node_modules/.bin/jest src/__tests__/integrations.linearWebhook.test.ts --runInBand --forceExit` — PASS, 22 tests.
- Local attempted: `tsc --noEmit` after dependency symlink — blocked by missing `twitter-api-v2` in the reused dependency tree; attempted `npm ci` in isolated worktree, but the machine has only ~3.3GiB free and npm failed with `ENOSPC` before a full local dependency tree could be installed.
- GitHub Actions: `Detect changed projects`, `Backend tests (agentMode)`, and `Backend tests (all other + coverage)` passed.

## What was NOT tested

- I did not send real Resend emails, patch real Featurebase tickets, or send real Slack pings.
- I did not touch production DynamoDB tables.
- I did not complete a local full TypeScript check because the local machine ran out of disk space during dependency install; relying on GitHub backend checks for the broader suite.
- Partner portal tests and backend staging deploy were skipped by CI because this PR only changes backend webhook handling/tests/docs.

Fixes ENG-222.

title: [defense] Map reported priority onto the Linear field
body:
Source: https://fathom.video/calls/735303724?timestamp=1943.9999

Human bug report/ask: In the 2026-07-07 Argusoft <> AgentWeb meeting, Anurag reported that tasks whose description said high/urgent priority still showed Linear priority as None/Set priority, making triage order unreliable; Harsha said he would make sure the real Linear priority field gets set.

## Risk: Low | Priority: High

## What was wrong (before)
Auto-generated bug issues said `Priority: High` in the **description text** while the actual Linear priority field stayed **None**, filed into **Backlog, unassigned** — invisible to priority-sorted triage (Argusoft's report, 2026-07-07). `createInternalLinearIssue` never set `priority`/`assigneeId` and always filed to Backlog; Emma's `report_product_issues` priority param was rendered as text only (`issueContext['Priority']` → `contextLines`).

## What this fixes (after)
The reporter-stated priority becomes the real Linear field (urgent=1 / high=2 / medium=3 / low=4; absent or unrecognized → **Medium**, never "No priority"). **High and Urgent** bug canonicals additionally land in **Todo** and are **assigned to the default bug assignee** (Harshit Shah; env override `LINEAR_BUG_DEFAULT_ASSIGNEE_ID`). Medium/Low keep today's Backlog placement (full "every bug arrives Todo" is ENG-187's scope).

## Behavioral assertions verified (contract from Harsha, 2026-07-07 — ENG-231)
1. High+ task → priority field set + Todo + Argusoft assignee → `intakeService.test.ts` "High -> priority field 2 + lands in Todo + assigned", "Urgent -> priority field 1 + Todo + assignee"; `linearService.test.ts` "maps priority + assignee + Todo state onto the issueCreate input"
2. Text and field never disagree (same source value) → `priority: issue.priority` at the tool call site feeds both; covered by assertion-1 tests
3. No stated priority → Medium (3), never None → "no stated priority -> Medium (3)" + "unrecognized priority text -> Medium (3)"
4. Medium/Low unescalated → "Low -> priority field 4, stays in Backlog unassigned"

## How to test
1. In Emma (test env), send: "report a bug: the dashboard crashes when I save, this is high priority" so `report_product_issues` fires with `priority: High`
2. **Expected**: the new ENG issue shows priority **High** (the field, not just text), state **Todo**, assignee **Harshit Shah**
3. Repeat with a low-priority phrasing
4. **Expected**: priority field **Low**, state **Backlog**, unassigned

## Edge cases to check
- A duplicate High re-report groups onto an existing canonical without creating a new issue (and deliberately does NOT escalate the existing one — see 'not covered')

## Test Evidence
- `npx tsc` clean
- `intakeService.test.ts` + `linearService.test.ts`: 32 passed (8 new), 0 failed — TDD: the 8 new tests were verified failing before implementation
- All 6 adjacent suites touching `report_product_issues`/`fileUserIssue`: 56 passed, 0 failed

## Files changed
- `backend/src/services/linearService.ts` — `todoStateId` in TeamMeta; optional `priority`/`assigneeId`/`startInTodo` on `createInternalLinearIssue`
- `backend/src/services/intakeService.ts` — priority text→field map + High+ escalation in `fileBugReport`
- `backend/src/emma/tools.ts` — pass `issue.priority` through to `fileUserIssue`
- tests + `dev.md` note

## What was NOT tested
- Full backend suite (structural ~15 min; targeted suites above were run)
- Live Linear `issueCreate` end-to-end (mocked at the GraphQL boundary)
- Dup-grouped High re-reports do NOT bump an existing canonical's priority — deliberate scope cut; the board-doc reporter-count modifier may want it later (noted in dev.md)
- `fileAutoIssue` telemetry/oncall filings still land unset/Backlog by design (no text/field mismatch there)
